purpose: Test whether a novel anomaly cluster survives a deliberately different evidence projection rather than merely two distance functions over the same potentially biased fields.
mechanism_placeholder: multi-view consistency across disjoint acceptance-relevant feature projections
fixed_scope: Constructed role-local anomaly trace only; agreement across two disjoint views is a robustness guard and does not prove conditional independence or semantic truth.
disjointness_rule: VIEW_A_CONTROL and VIEW_B_OUTCOME share zero feature fields. A copied, renamed, or overlapping projection cannot count as the second view.
support_rule: The same unique anomaly identities U1,U2,U3 must form a supported candidate core under both disjoint views using each view's frozen equality/one-mismatch neighborhood. If memberships disagree, no taxonomy activation or credit; view definitions cannot be changed after outcome observation in the same generation.

fixed_trace.expected: ineligible because projections are not materially distinct
feature-view consensus; candidate may proceed only after both view artifacts are sealed/read back

fixed_trace.control: VIEW_A core U1,U2,U3; VIEW_B core U1,U2 only
fixed_trace.expected: feature-view disagreement; block activation and credit

fixed_trace.event: after disagreement move terminal_effect_class into VIEW_A or relax VIEW_B
transport/duplicate/stale anomaly is present in both view traces
late completion from old view/taxonomy generation

fixed_trace.control: no disjoint view pair agrees on core
fixed_trace.expected: remain unresolved with frontier_nonempty=true and zero new credit

guards.G1: view feature sets and neighborhood rules are frozen before public source audit
guards.G2: second view must be feature-disjoint; copied/overlapping views are ineligible
guards.G3: same supported core identities must appear in both views
guards.G5: post-outcome view or threshold tuning is forbidden in the same generation
guards.G6: only unique terminal same-scope anomalies can enter supported cores
guards.G7: transport failures, duplicates, and stale anomalies cannot create cross-view support
guards.G8: both view artifacts must be durably sealed/read back before any later taxonomy activation
guards.G10: no-consensus control remains unresolved with nonempty frontier
guards.G11: terminal leaf artifact must be independently read back before any role-local credit
guards.G12: accepted route has zero residual richer/protected/manual execution, zero finite optional monthly/trial/paid quota dependency, and zero incremental monetary cost

acceptance: PASS only if G1-G12 hold after public-source mechanism binding; no post-source view/rubric edits.
credit_rule: Precommit earns zero credit; at most one role-local credit after terminal readback.
frontier_if_terminal: Select another non-conflicting switching/recovery failure mode; preserve the limitation that hand-selected disjoint views can still encode a common designer bias.
